skill.name: seo-content-planner
skill.description: Creates comprehensive content outlines and topic clusters for SEO. Plans content calendars and identifies topic gaps. Use PROACTIVELY for content strategy and planning.
skill.summary: Plans SEO topic clusters, content outlines, keyword targeting, and publishing calendars.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The two static findings are false positives caused by markdown backticks and a fenced output template in SKILL.md. No evidence found of executable command usage, data exfiltration intent, or prompt injection attempts in the reviewed file.

static_findings.snippet: - If detailed examples are required, open `resources/implementation-playbook.md`.

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 25 uses markdown inline code to name a referenced playbook path, not Ruby or shell execution. The text is instruction prose and contains no executable command.
Lines 73-89 are a markdown fenced example showing the expected content outline format. The block contains headings and placeholders, not executable Ruby or shell code.

content.value_statement: SEO planning can become scattered across keywords, outlines, and calendars. This skill turns a topic into organized clusters, outlines, priorities, and publishing plans.
actual_capabilities: Builds topic cluster plans with pillar pages and supporting article ideas.
Creates structured content outlines with audience, intent, keywords, sections, word counts, and internal links.
Maps informational, commercial, and transactional intent for planned content.
Prioritizes topics for creation order and publishing sequence.
Drafts 30 to 60 day content calendars with topic, keyword, format, and priority details.
Suggests formats such as guides, FAQs, glossaries, comparisons, case studies, tools, and resources.
limitations: Does not include built-in live keyword volume, SERP, or competitor data collection.
Requires user-provided topics, audiences, keywords, markets, or research inputs for accurate planning.
Does not publish content, update a CMS, or create analytics reports.
The referenced implementation playbook is not included in the package.

use_cases.title: Build a Topic Cluster
use_cases.description: Turn one core topic into a pillar page, supporting articles, FAQs, comparisons, and internal link targets.

use_cases.title: Plan Client SEO Work
use_cases.description: Create outlines, keyword targets, and publishing priorities for a client campaign.

use_cases.title: Organize an Editorial Calendar
use_cases.description: Convert approved topics into a 30 to 60 day publishing plan with formats and priorities.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Basic Outline
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a content outline for [topic] targeting [audience] with informational search intent and primary keyword [keyword].

prompt_templates.title: Create a Topic Cluster
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a topic cluster for [pillar topic] with supporting articles, search intent, internal links, and publishing priority.

prompt_templates.title: Build an SEO Calendar
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a 60 day SEO calendar for [site] using these keywords: [list]. Include format, word count, and internal link targets.

prompt_templates.title: Map Competitive Gaps
prompt_templates.prompt: Find content gaps from this competitor list: [competitors]. Map opportunities to clusters, outlines, and a prioritized production sequence.

output_examples.input: Topic: email deliverability for SaaS teams.
output: Pillar guide: Improve Email Deliverability for SaaS Products.
Supporting articles cover authentication, list hygiene, reputation monitoring, bounce handling, and inbox placement.
Calendar starts with the pillar guide, then publishes technical and operational support articles.

output_examples.input: Audience: local dental clinics planning service pages.
output: Cluster includes service pages, local intent FAQs, comparison content, and patient education articles.
Internal links connect high-intent service pages with supporting guides.
Priority favors procedures with clear commercial intent and existing clinic expertise.

output_examples.input: Keywords and competitor topics for a product analytics blog.
output: Gap analysis highlights missing content for feature adoption, event tracking, dashboard design, and reporting workflows.
Outlines define target readers, intent, sections, keyword variants, and recommended word counts.
Publishing order starts with high-intent comparison topics, then builds supporting educational pages.

best_practices: Provide audience, primary market, business goals, and any existing keyword research.
Ask for separate plans when topics have different audiences or search intent.
Review outlines against brand expertise and update priorities after performance data arrives.
anti_patterns: Using the plan as final keyword research without validating demand or ranking difficulty.
Combining unrelated product lines into one pillar topic.
Requesting a full calendar without audience, market, or publishing capacity details.

faq.question: Can this skill replace an SEO tool?
faq.answer: No. It organizes strategy and outlines, but it does not provide live search volume or ranking data.

faq.question: Does it work in Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The package declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What inputs should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide topic, audience, market, goals, seed keywords, competitors, and publishing capacity.

faq.question: Can it make a content calendar?
faq.answer: Yes. It can draft 30 to 60 day plans with topics, keywords, formats, links, and priority.

faq.question: Does it write complete articles?
faq.answer: It focuses on planning, outlines, clusters, and calendars rather than finished long-form copy.

faq.question: Can it identify topic gaps?
faq.answer: Yes. It can compare provided topics and competitors to suggest missing content opportunities.
